# Agent Setup Bundle: Multi-Platform AI Engineering Operating System
> Production-ready, cross-platform configuration framework, 16 core rules (PRAR, Zero Speculation, Context Engineering, Interactive Planning Mode, Session Handoff), 36 modular skills (agentskills.io), and MCP configurations for OpenAI Codex, Antigravity / Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Modern Cursor IDE.

## Core Capabilities
- **Universal Multi-Platform Support**: Native installers for Windows (PowerShell `install.ps1`), Linux & macOS (Bash `install.sh`), and Python (`install.py`).
- **16 Operational Rules**: Enforcing PRAR workflow, Interactive Planning Protocol (`/plan`), Context Engineering, Subagent Zero Context Bleed, TypeScript Safety Gate (`npx tsc --noEmit`), Root Cause debugging, and Anti-Destruction policies.
- **36 Production Skills**: Covering Architecture, Context Engineering & Orchestration, Frontend & UI/UX, Backend, Systems & MCP Builder, AI/Data Science, and QA/Auditing.
- **Project-Level Blueprints (`AGENTS.md`)**: AAIF-standard repository context templates providing deterministic execution parameters.

## Documentation & Key Links
- [Autonomous Installation Guide](AGENTS.md): Deterministic instructions for AI coding assistants.
- [Master Technical Documentation](README.md): Architecture, skill taxonomy, and MCP configuration playbook.
- [Universal Bootstrap Prompts](PROMPT_FOR_AI.md): One-shot prompts for web and chat AI interfaces.
- [Platform Manifests](core/): Dedicated system rules for Codex, Gemini, Claude, and Cursor.
